description: WINDMI represents the coupled solar-wind, magnetosphere and ionosphere system with a reduced dynamical model. It supports analysis of energy transfer and geomagnetic activity. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RingCurrent; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run, Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Reduced-order state variables cannot represent every spatial detail of the coupled plasma environment. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
